subject: Tomorrow is Easter - Celebrate with Luca
body:
Tomorrow we celebrate Easter, the resurrection of Christ—a profound symbol of the soul's triumph over limitation and the promise of spiritual renewal.

Easter is not only a commemoration of a great event, but a joyful invitation to experience resurrection within ourselves. The story of Easter reminds us to embrace new beginnings, playfulness, and the surprising beauty of transformation in our lives.

As you celebrate, consider these playful and creative questions to explore with Luca:
{{exampleQuestions}}

May this Easter fill your heart with fresh joy and inspiration on the path of spiritual rebirth.

In divine friendship,
The Luca Team
